title: The context map regrounded: workflow's relation recorded, delivery's corrected, two concepts placed
situation: Regrounding the bounded contexts from first principles (2026-10-13) found the workflow's relation never recorded, delivery's relation stale after 0142 and 0144, and two concepts in the wrong place.
decision: The workflow's relation is recorded; delivery's is corrected; implementation leakage is folded into the concept journal as the warning it gives and retired as a concept of its own; the completion check moves to the development context unchanged. The operator concurred.
consequences: The context map reads the same as the regrounding documents.
